title: Our new kitten
instructions: Sara ailesinin yeni yavru kedisini anlatıyor. Nereden geldiğine ve ne yaptığına dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last week, we got a new kitten from an animal shelter.

script.speaker: s
script.text: She is grey with white feet, so we called her Socks.

script.speaker: s
script.text: She's only ten weeks old, and she sleeps most of the day.

script.speaker: s
script.text: At night, she plays with everything, even my hair!

script.speaker: s
script.text: My dog was scared of her at first, but now they're friends.

Why did they call her Socks?
